avis.texte: I really love this moisturizer for the winter! I get extremely dry skin and this helps so much! I used it everyday at night and my skin became less flaky with dry skin. For the summer, this moisturizer is a little too heavy for my skin. This is just my preference.

I have used Clinique dramatically different moisturizing lotion for over 40 years. It is my go to for everyday moisture and a must before I apply sunscreen. It is perfect for the humid South Florida weather.
This moisturizer spreads smoothly and absorbs quickly. Lasts all day

Busted my skin barrier from trying a different moisturizer. This saved and left my skin feeling hydrated and soft, not just at the surface! skin doesn't feel tight. Love. Continuing to use. I also really like that I put it on before bed and come morning my skin still feels hydrated, soft, and not tight :)

Im not sure how this prduct has so many good reviews. It smells like a mans hand after hes been working on the car all day. And im lathering it all over my face-yuck. It doesbt do anything magical. It feels like every other moisturiser out there on the market, just with an added stink.
This lotion goes on so smoothly, leaving no oily residue. This was also my Mother's favorite lotion, she used it for years.
That only is the Clinique moisturizer fantastic, your 21 day sale is amazing. I have been back three times this week to get my favorite products. Thank you Ulta!

avis.titre: NOT fragrance free, filled with cheap OILS
avis.texte: Cute how Clinique products claim to be "fragrance free", then put lanolin or linalool in all of them. This product is NOT fragrance free; it contains lanolin - check the ingredient list closely. It is also filled with cheap oils; mineral oil is the 2nd ingredient on the list (so how is this so much $$??), petroleum is another (same as pore-clogging vaseline), sesame oil (the cheap junk used on our french fries), & sunflower seed cake/oil (the #1 worst seed oil i've ever put on my face to date yet), therefore, I cannot recommend this product to anyone. Especially if you have sensitive skin, or are at all acne prone, steer clear of this. It is false advertising, & they are charging an exorbitant price for the cheapest of cheap ingredients (that mess up everyone's flesh - not just mine; I don't even have sensitive/acne prone skin, & this wrecked me.)

avis.titre: MINERAL OIL (2nd ingredient), petroleum & fragrance; RUN!
avis.texte: How is this so pricey, when it's all MINERAL OIL?? + PETROLEUM, + fragrance (linalool), + a slew of other cheap oils, all which cause deeply painful cystic acne?? So much for "oil-free" & "dermatologist tested". These terms mean nothing anymore. If I wanted to break out his badly, i would've bought some cheap $1 mineral oil & vaseline, & slathered that on. The other oils aren't helpful either. Stop putting this cheap junk in our face products!! Ohhh, wait - i get it...great business model. Cuz now we all need to buy 89 more products to correct &/or hide the mess this made. Great for profits; not so great for our flesh. I wouldn't pay $1 for this MINERAL OIL (& petroleum) based product; it's the 2nd ingredient in the list!! It has taken me over 4 weeks to try to fix my face after using this. It's also stupid light weight; not even remotely close to being "hydrating." I'd say it's probably OK for oily skin - but NOPE, not when it's literally all OILS it's not. If u wanna try this, get some cheap mineral oil & vaseline & put that on. Tonsa $$ saved; same effect. xoxo

When they are on sale i buy allot to last me all year.
I've been using clinique products since I was 18 years old ( I'm 82 now) and my skin looks fantastic. I would recommend these products to everyone..

I have used this product since I discovered Clinique when I was 22 years old. The 3-step regimen became part of my daily routine and 47 years later I still consider it the best skin care on the market. There is something about this moisturizer that has always complemented my skin care routine. I have added other items - including Moisture Surge products to my daily program- but this moisturizer is always the item I reach for first. If compliments mean anything - at 69 years old, I will take them - I've been told my skin tone and overall skin appearance is that of a woman in her early 40's. ❤️ Compliments are great and they are due to Clinique!

avis.titre: I'VE BEEN USING THIS PRODUCT FOR YEARS!
avis.texte: I am a 45 year old woman. I have been using this product since I was about 14 years old. This is the most amazing moisturizer I have ever come across, especially now my skin is maturing.

avis.titre: Wishing for a zero waste option
avis.texte: I would feel better about using Clinique if the bottles were reused by the company. This is by far the best product for my skin. I keep coming back when I have a reaction or problem with something else. The reason I keep trying other brands is that I prefer a products with reusable design, where I can order more and send back my empty bottles to be refilled for a different order. That would probably involve a bottle redesign but I have paid more for reusable products. If Clinique had a reusable design, I'd tell all the zero waste stores and everyone I know.
At this price point I can't believe mineral oil is the 2nd ingredient. My skin loves it, but my wallet does not.

avis.texte: I have used Dramatically Different Lotion for 30+ years. My skin is extremely sensitive and I've never had a problem with this lotion or any Clinique products. I get compliments on my skin frequently.
I have been using this moisturizer for since the 1970's. Nothing better.

This is the perfect day time moisturizer. I use it year round. It hydrates really well and is fast-absorbing plus it doesn't pill under make-up. Accessible price point. Love that a large size is available as it makes a significant environmental impact!
Been using for almost 50 years. The only moisturizer I have ever used and I love it!💚💚💚
I really like Dramatically Different Moisturizing Lotion. I have very dry skin and it does a great job of moisturizing my skin.

avis.titre: If it isn't broken….don't fix it ❤️
avis.texte: I got my first 3 step kit at 13 and ever since I've been taking care of my skin with Clinique. I've added the pink gel moisturizer and two prescription strength creams to my regimen but the 3 step stays the same. Cliniques 3 step is the basics you need to keep your skin barrier healthy and its worked for me over 25 years. My daughter will be getting her first 3 step on her birthday in Oct 2026. It gets you in a regular routine of cleaning and moisturizing your skin and it becomes a habit and you won't ever go to bed without cleaning your face. Well, I never did. Regardless of what was going on…..even those late night "study" sessions lol in college….It was such a habit, I never went to sleep without doing my 3 step. I keep this size in my gym bag so I always have it on me. Fabulous skincare for genuinely amazing skin!

avis.titre: Really nice lotion for oily skin
avis.texte: As someone with oily skin, I was surprised by how well the Clinique "Yellow Lotion" worked for me. The texture looks a bit rich at first, but it absorbs quickly and doesn't leave a greasy film. It gives just the right amount of hydration without clogging pores, and it sits nicely under makeup. It doesn't control oil, so very oily skin might find it a bit too dewy in summer, but as a simple, reliable moisturizer, it's hard to go wrong with this one.

avis.titre: Bought as gift. Came loose not in sealed green box.
avis.texte: I ordered this online rather than buying in-store to be sure it was the authentic product. However it arrived loose in a shipping box with no sealed manufacturer's box, leading me to question its authenticity. I am embarrassed to give this as a gift when not in the "real packaging".

avis.titre: Free facial moisturizer. Went back to buy more
avis.texte: I love this. It's great for your face ,especially in Colorado. Where the air is very dry. I have normal to dry facial skin and this works great for 4
I've been using this since I was a teen and still love it. Absorbs easily, hydrates, doesn't feel greasy... a great moisturizing cream.

avis.titre: Great product, VERY LOUSY DELIVERY SERVICE!!
avis.texte: I have been using DDML for over 25 years. This product never disappoints. It's one of the few products I can use very close to my eyes and never have a reaction to as I have sensitive eyes. I use it daily especially in the freezing winter months. My only complaint is the delivery service ONTRAC that is used in our area S U C K S ! ! I really hope Clinique switches delivery services. 🙏🙏🙏
I have used ALL of Clinique's skincare/makeup products for 50+ years and I surprise people, even medical doctors, by my age! Do yourself a favor and start it NOW!!
I have been using this moisturizer for many years. always good. under makeup and at night. good for sensative skin. no perfume.

I started using this kind-to-your-face, no scent moisturizer back in the 1980s! It's taken me from my teens to 50s, keeping my skin glowing, soft, and has kept itchy, flaking seborrheic dermatitis on my face under control all these years. I really notice when I miss applying the moisturizer for a few days. It's been the best moisturizer I've ever used.

This is the third bottle that I've used. My skin is dehydrated and this helped my skin. I tried another Clinique cream (100hours), but it didn't work for my skin. This is amazing specifically under the makeup, make your make-up like velvet, smoothly.

avis.titre: No box and bottle was not full

This is concerning as I do not feel safe using a product that looks used and not in a box. I tried to call consumer care and was transferred multiple times to the point my calls were dropped. Do better, Clinique!!!
I ordered it for myself, and I loved it. I have very sensitive, dry skin, and this product is perfect for it. Not irritating and no rash.
This lotion is great. Provides enough for the winter months and also not too thick for the summer months.

It gives long-lasting hydration and leaves my skin feeling healthy and balanced. I also appreciate that it's fragrance-free and suitable for sensitive skin. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable daily moisturizer.
makes my dry, flaky skin feel moisturized. works well under makeup as well.
This is my favorite daily moisturizer. It goes on so smooth before my makeup.

avis.titre: I've used this for over 20 years and still look amazing

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Yellow out the bottle but blends clear. Thick texture, so a little goes a long way. Hydrating, with SPF 35 for daily use. Love the packaging and how easy it is to open and use.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] So good! It best for dry skin. I love that it has spf in it. Packaging is very chic and I love hoq fresh it smells. Overall a very good day time moisturizer for dry skin.
I love this. I have been using it for years. It is perfect for under makeup. I also ordered the SPF version & I can't wait to try it

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this moisturizer for a few days now and I'm obsessed. It's super light, not greasy at all, and makes my skin feel really soft. I love that it has SPF 35—makes it easy to remember sunscreen in the morning without adding an extra step. It also works great under makeup. Definitely a new staple in my routine!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cream from the Clinique brand is super good because it contains sunscreen and absorbs very well into the face. It has no fragrance, only that of sunscreen. Its texture is soft and oily. Its ingredients are glycerin, butylene glycol, and many more.

I received the Clinique Dramatically Different Moisturizing Lotion + SPF 35 for free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I live in Las Vegas, so I like anything that has sunscreen in it. This is lightweight, thin, but not runny. I know people say it is unscented, but I picked up a slight smell that reminded me of floating toys in a chlorinated pool. But that scent dissipated quickly. It does not leave a white cast and works well underneath make up.

I received a sample of the Clinique broad-spectrum SPF 35 to try and review. I was disappointed as I thought the sample would come in the pump bottle as shown in the photo, however, the sample arrived in a tube, which I think is not as hygienic as a pump. I like the texture of the lotion as it's thin, and not too runny. Totally wearable under makeup. I like that it doesn't leave a white cast, which is important . It's not noted as unscented, and there is no fragrance, but there is some kind of scent to the lotion which disappears soon after applying. The fact that the sunscreen is thin enough and doesn't leave a weird heavy feeling, I would likely buy in the future.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I really like using this moisturizing lotion. It goes on evenly without leaving a white cast. After using it for several days, my skin feels and looks more hydrated. I also really like that it has an SPF of 35.
Great product the moisturizer keeps my face moisturizer and vibrant the entire day. My face looks beautiful and more natural!
I use this moisturizer year round. I have combination skin and this is perfect for me. It doesn't leave my skin greasy or oily.

I was very disappointed when the original dramatically different moisturizing lotion was replaced by this. It just felt like my face couldn't breathe after applying it, like there was a plastic film over my face, accompanied by some burning sensation. I decided to give it another try recently. Sadly, the same effects happened. Why, oh why did you discontinue the original!

. This product didn't seem to hydrate my skin, it is very runny and yellow in color due to coloring dyes. It goes on very shiny but eventually that shine fades away. I had no issues applying my makeup on top of the lotion and there was no white cast. It says no fragrance but it does have that sunblock scent.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This Clinique product is the first moisturizer that I ever used on my face, and it is back better than ever! I can't remember why I stopped using it back in the day, but I suspect that it was because I now spend a lot of time in the sun at my job and needed spf. And I had no idea that my favorite Clinique moisturizer, in the familiar floral box, and yellow tube, is now made with sun protection! Winner! I have always loved this formula, especially in the summer, because it sinks in fast, is not overly greasy, and has a very mild, pleasant scent. The only thing that I would love to change, is that it would be super convenient to have a flip top, instead of the the screw-on lid. Keep the iconic silver lid, but just make it easier to open and close for older gals like myself. Overall though, I am still in love with this moisturizer, and thrilled to see it now has SPF. I received this compliment product in exchange for my honest opinion.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Came in a nice package I feel like the texture is good it's kinda more liquid and when you apply to your skin it smothing in with your skin quick I feel like the sent is good not bad just the smell that comes with most products also I feel like it's good for really dry skin. my mother also tried it and loved it her skin is really dry and and she used it first and then she put makeup on and looked so good and she also felt her skin kinda change and I also did too

avis.titre: I love this product for my skin
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Broad Spectrum SPF 35 The packaging is perfect, as it is easy to use, it protects extremely well from the sun's rays, the ingredients are super good for the skin, the texture is liquid and is easy to apply on the face and spread, the fragrance is fresh, I love this product for my skin.

I've been using this lotion since my mom bought it for me as a teen. I went though my twenties exploring cheaper and more widely available lotions and they just aren't as good. This one cares for my dry face and neck skin in a way no other product I've tried does. With that moisturized base, anything else I put on my skin also works better - I use the redness reducer foundation which is also a game changer. But it works BEST when applied after this excellent lotion. I'll buy this one forever.

I ordered two lotions and they arrived without original packaging boxes, which makes me hard to trust if these are new items. I've been using this lotion for years and never had them without Clinique packaging when I ordered from Clinique. I went to a local store to request an exchange, and they said jumbo size does not come in boxes. However, I clearly remember that when I ordered a jumbo size from other stores including Clinique, I received it sealed and packaged in a box. This is my first time ordering through Ulta and I'm hugely disappointed.

avis.titre: Great Moisturizer for Face and Neck
avis.texte: I ordered this for a moisturizer for my face and neck. I just turned 30 so I'm wanting to take better care of my face. I could see and feel a difference in my face and neck. It does not feel dry. Works well by itself or under foundation. I have sensitive skin so this hasn't made my face break out. You don't need a lot only a little.
Have been using this moisturizer for many years and love it as much today as when I first started using it! Keeps my face feeling smooth and hydrated and never feels heavy or greasy.
I recall using Clinique brand starting skin care as a teen. Clean ingredients and easy three step process. The moisturizer is unmatched and a must overt the cetaphil brand

I applied to my face & neck for 2 days, & broke out in a rash, didn't change anything else, still itchy after 5 days.. I checked the ingredients and noticed there is dyes in there.. my fault for not checking ingredients I guess.
skin has been covered in red, itchy, burning rashes after two uses. had to go to the walk in urgent care for relief, skin is still extremely dry and itchy

avis.titre: Good layering moisturizer for your western vacation
avis.texte: So i spent a week out west with my husband and if youve ever been out west you know how that the air and heat shrivel up the moisture content in your skin and turn you into a crepey corpse. Well it did for me haha i love this as a first step moisturizer before i go in with a second thicker one. This has urea wich is amazing for crepey skin!
